segments.name: Heavy construction equipment
segments.description: Sells and rents heavy construction equipment to customers, mainly in Singapore and the region.
segments.evidence: In accordance with ASC 280, Segment Reporting ("ASC 280"), the Company has determined that it operates in one reportable operating segment, consistent with how management evaluates performance and allocates resources.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company to buy or rent heavy construction equipment, and for related services.
revenueModel.evidence: We operate in the heavy construction equipment sales and rental business, which is highly competitive.
